game_concept: A card battler set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about slice_ok to power up the spirit seeker and open the rune gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 9 (extended tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Collapsed Dome'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Collapsed Dome.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 11.
